title: Command
description: Canonical command envelope sent from the SCADA/application layer to a bridge device.

command_id.description: Unique command identifier used for correlation, queue/retry and deduplication. This is the canonical field name.

request_id.description: Alias for command_id. Some MQTT publishers use request_id (string) instead of command_id (integer). The bridge accepts either. When both are present, request_id takes precedence.

correlation_id.description: Optional external correlation id (e.g. UUID) for end-to-end tracing.

command_name.description: Name of the command to execute on the device.

arguments.description: Positional arguments passed to the command.

items.description: Printable ASCII, 1-64 bytes. Must not contain: comma, asterisk, at-sign, CR or LF.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC) when the command was issued.

ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live in seconds before the command is considered stale by the bridge.
